integrity: The counterexample and repair are proved directly from the stated definitions. No numerical experiment or inaccessible source is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem-level counterclaim is scoped to arXiv:2305.08182v1; the full text of the later reedited journal copy was not independently inspected.
Injectivity is proved sufficient for the repaired proposition; it is not claimed to be necessary for every individual operator orbit.
No claim is made about unrelated results in the source.
title: A noninjective obstruction to operator-orbit linear independence for g-fusion frames
